units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> (play on <he>תמתי</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2">ib.</cite>) <he>תְּאוֹמָתִי מה הת׳ הללו וכ׳</he> my twin sister, as in the case of twins, when one has a headache, the other feels it, so, as it were, does the Lord say, ‘with him (Israel) am I in distress’ (<cite ref="Psalms 91:15">Ps. XCI, 15</cite>).
Gen. R. s. 85; a. e.—Esp. Gemini, a constellation of the Zodiac.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מזל ת׳ אדם</he> (read: <he>מזל אדם ת׳</he>) man’s planet is Gemini. Tanḥ. Haăz. 1 [read:] <he>וכשגדל נעשה כת׳ כלומר שלם וכ׳</he> when man grows up, he becomes like the planet Gemini, that is to say, perfect &c.—Fem. <he>תְּאוֹמָה</he>. Cant. R. l. c., v. supra. Ib. <he>תאומתי כביכול</he>, v. <cite ref="V00428"><he>תְּיוֹמֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:2">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>קין ותְאוֹמָתוֹ</he> Cain and his twin sister.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Ib.</cite> <he>ת׳ יתירה נולדה וכ׳</he> an additional twin sister was born with Abel; a. e.—Pl. <he>תְּאוֹמוֹת</he>.
Ib. הבל ושתי תְאוֹמוֹתָיו Abel and his two sisters born with him.—Trnsf. תְּאוֹמוֹת (from their shape) molar teeth.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:4">Bekh. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 39a">39ᵃ</cite>) Ar. (Mish. ed. <cite ref="M03007"><he>מַתְאִימוֹת</he></cite>; Bab. ed. <cite ref="V00428"><he>תיומת</he></cite>).
